agent_notes: Search results were used only for discovery; official pages on www.knit.ac.in were the sole evidence for identity, campus, description, programmes, durations, and eligibility.
The official catalogue lists B.tech., MCA, M.tech. full-time, M.tech part-time, and Ph. d. programmes; no diploma or certificate programme is listed.

Duration and eligibility remain null where the official pages did not explicitly verify the fact; in particular, the official M.Tech full-time admission section did not state an eligibility requirement.

Normal TLS verification failed with the managed proxy self-signed certificate-chain error; the permitted --insecure fallback was used only for public GET requests to the expected official/search hostnames.
Career-tree mappings were produced from read-only sqlite3 queries against assets/data/career_path.db; Humanities and Applied sciences has no responsible local node.
